title: The Sweet Harbor
author: Mirabel Joubert
blurb: Casper Almeida, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
